decisions.scope: Ende Jg.6 observable within-species and nonpurposeful generational variation; no required genetic mechanism
decisions.rationale: One observation and explanation of variation across examples; not independent mutation, meiosis or selection routines. Describing how differences occur without a developmental aim supports the source explanatory demand rather than just listing features.
decisions.prerequisites: Only orientation remains after current parent and transitive inheritance.

decisions.scope: Ende Jg.10 simple chromosome-section gene instructions to product to trait relation; no molecular process
decisions.rationale: Chromosomal location and product/trait effect form a single causally connected model, not a protein-structure or biosynthesis task. Products contribute to traits, avoiding one-gene-one-trait determinism.
decisions.prerequisites: Current b1 cell comparison and its real microscope/plant-cell/orientation chain; no DNA, replication or protein-biosynthesis prerequisite.

decisions.scope: Ende Jg.10 nonmolecular mutation/recombination origin and selection effect
decisions.rationale: The operative correction distinguishes origin of variants from selection on existing variation, an integrated causal account. Recombination combines inherited variants; selection must not be accepted as generating mutations in response to need.
decisions.prerequisites: The proposed 1d simplified meiosis replaces ffef molecular mutation classification; full inherited chain independently reconstructed and matches candidate.

minimalResidualResolutionProposal.title: Erbgleichheit von Körperzellen mit Mitose begründen
minimalResidualResolutionProposal.description: Die lernende Person kann an einem einfachen Chromosomenmodell begründen, warum bei der Mitose nach vorheriger Verdopplung und gleichmäßiger Verteilung des Erbmaterials genetisch gleiche Körperzellen entstehen.
minimalResidualResolutionProposal.descriptionEn: The learner can use a simple chromosome model to explain why mitosis produces genetically identical somatic cells after prior copying and equal distribution of the genetic material.
minimalResidualResolutionProposal.source: Actual FW6-004 printed87 Ende Jg.10; no new synthetic molecular replication source atom.
minimalResidualResolutionProposal.prerequisiteProposal: b1 cell understanding; simple chromosome-copy/distribution legend can be supplied. Do not require e70 DNA-structure or replication mechanisms.
minimalResidualResolutionProposal.qualification: Independent new candidate proposal only; requires its own actual cases, two D reviews and A/M/V/source/view integration.
